build_rolling_stats_zscore_anomaly_detec: build a RollingStatsModel with z_score statistics to detect anomalies in a univariate time series
create_rolling_stats_iqr_detector: create a RollingStatsModel using iqr statistics to detect outliers via interquartile range on time series data
run_modified_zscore_mad_detection: run a RollingStatsModel with modified_z_score_mad statistics to detect anomalies using median and MAD
test_rolling_stats_with_seasonality_remo: test a RollingStatsModel with remove_seasonality enabled and a daily seasonality period on time series data
refactor_rolling_stats_expanding_window: refactor a RollingStatsModel to use allow_expanding_window when historical data is shorter than the rolling window
